rule_source: (structural no-simple-vertex (n) :domain (6) :source "S12 (DFMV03 Remark 3: stated for n = 6, 7; m_3 and the m_5 anticut are simple)" :doc "No vertex is simple (incidence = C(n,2)); literature: true for n = 6, 7, false at n = 8 (orbits 532, 533)." (forall ((x (vertices n))) (> (incidence x) (binom n 2))))
